finding: P26 rows were repair draft rows, not a materialized dataset candidate.
fix: Normalized all 8 P26 rows into P27 dataset rows with schemaVersion, pairId, selected/rejected skills, chosen/rejected behavior, target adapter, source family, local-private status, commonTrainingAllowed=false, and notUsedForTrainingYet=true.

finding: Rows could be misread as common SkillSelection semantic quality evidence.
fix: Added intendedMachineOrState per adapter and explicit no-overclaim flags; P27 is only data materialization for future PromptContextSkillSelectionUnitState and SkillSelectionSkillUnitState repair.

finding: Lineage needed to connect P24 holdout rows, P25 failures, and P26 draft rows without losing provenance.
fix: Added derivedFrom, sourceHash/sourceRef, p25FailureEvidence, and P27 source-disjoint status on every row.

finding: Dataset card needed to avoid claiming training authorization from the existence of checked rows.
fix: Added p27-training-authorization-ledger.json with trainingAllowed=false, candidateTrainingAllowed=false, commonTrainingAllowed=false, and separate next-slice gate requirements.

finding: Source-disjoint wording needed to distinguish P24 checkpoint disjointness from future common-training eligibility.
fix: Added quarantine ledger: P24/P25/P26 lineage proves repair need and local holdout disjointness, while p27SourceDisjointForCommonTraining=false and common reuse requires Luba approval.

finding: Artifacts needed self-checkable evidence without touching models or tests unnecessarily.
fix: Added self-check scaffold and evidence card; no focused test was created because JSON/JSONL/schema gates are sufficient for this data-only slice.

finding: A conservative scan could misread forbiddenInP27.trainingRun=true as a training execution claim.
fix: Replaced the forbidden-action boolean object with forbiddenActionsInP27 string list so no training/checkpoint/promotion true flags appear in dataset rows.
